name: pi-mobile-typing-utils
description: Pi extension(s) for better mobile typing — word-by-word autocorrect for SSH/Termux sessions where Gboard's autocorrect is disabled.
author: cartwmic

scripts.dev:install: npm run build && node -e "console.log(['Build complete.', '', 'Load directly from the repo root with:', '  pi -e ./dist/index.js', '', 'Or copy the compiled extension for auto-discovery:', '  mkdir -p ~/.pi/agent/extensions/mobile-autocorrect', '  cp -r dist data ~/.pi/agent/extensions/mobile-autocorrect/', '', 'After rebuilding in a running Pi session, use:', '  npm run dev:reload-hint'].join('\n'))"
scripts.dev:reload-hint: node -e "console.log('Run /reload in your Pi session to reload after rebuild.')"
